messages:
Maria K: Heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/14222 to add per-model fallback routing and a small change to eviction headers. Need runtime eyes + sigsec sign-off before canary.
Sam R: pinging @Priya and @Tara for runtime/security reviews :eyes:
Priya (runtime): I can take a look in ~45m. quick skim: does this change any kernel selection logic or only routing metadata?
Maria K: only routing metadata + a small header tweak used by the autoscaler. no kernel changes. added unit tests and an integration smoke job in the PR description.
Jon P: FYI there was flakiness in the integration smoke on Friday — see logs I pasted in the PR. might be unrelated but worth running the canary longer.
Tara L: I'll review security surface. main question: does the header contain any customer-identifying info? if so we need a redaction step.
Maria K: header currently includes instance_id and candidate_pool tag. not customer id. added comment explaining redaction plan.
Priya (runtime): ok on kernel/routing. main runtime ask: can we gate the rollout with the existing fallback policy and a low-traffic canary for 2 hours? also add a metric tag so we can measure evictions by variant.
Maria K: yes to both — rollback policy already added and metric tag is in the PR (see last commit).
Tara L: security ack pending one tiny change: add a short lived token check in the header parsing path so malformed headers don't get accepted. I'll leave a code comment.
Maria K: good catch, will patch now.
Sam R: can someone with merge rights schedule the canary window if we get approvals? prefer asap today during the 2–4pm PST window.
Jon P: I'm on merge duty this afternoon. if sec + runtime approve before 1:30pm PST I can queue it for 2pm.
SecurityBot: automated SCA: no new high sev findings. dependency check passed.
Priya (runtime): Reviewed and approved — left two nits about log levels. :thumbsup:
Tara L: Security review complete. requested token-check commit looks good. approving after Maria pushes fix. :shipit:
Maria K: pushed fix at commit 89f3b2. thanks all.
Sam R: great — @Jon P you good to merge and kickoff canary at 14:00 PST?
Jon P: yes. will merge at +10 and monitor the first 30m. ping me in #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Maria K: really appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. will follow up with canary dashboard link once up. :raised_hands:
